lines.text: If Israel does not obey the LORD, curses will come, and they will be cursed in the city and the country.
The LORD will strike them with disease and drought, making the sky bronze and the earth iron.
The LORD will bring Israel and their king to a nation they have not known, where they will worship gods of gold.
The LORD will bring a nation from afar, and it will besiege their cities until their high fortified walls fall.
The LORD will return them to Babylon in ships, where they will sell themselves as slaves, but no one will buy them.
